solution:
The correct answer is __**i - c, ii - a, iii - d, iv - b**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Balanced Growth Theory** is associated with **Ragnar Nurkse**.
 
• **Big Push Theory** is attributed to **Rosenstein Rodan**.
 
• **Secular Deterioration** is linked to **Prebisch-Singer**.
 
• **Capital Goods and Heavy Industry** is related to **Feldman-Mahalanobis**.
 
• Thus, the correct matching is **i - c, ii - a, iii - d, iv - b**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ragnar Nurkse** was an Estonian international economist known for his contributions to the theory of balanced growth.
 
• **Rosenstein Rodan** was an Austrian economist who introduced the Big Push Theory, emphasizing the need for large-scale investments to overcome underdevelopment.
 
• **Prebisch-Singer hypothesis** suggests that over the long term, the price of primary commodities declines in relation to the price of manufactured goods, leading to deteriorating terms of trade for countries that export primary commodities.
 
• **Feldman-Mahalanobis model** was an economic development model proposed by Soviet economist G. A. Feldman and later adapted by Indian statistician P.C. Mahalanobis, focusing on the role of heavy industry in economic development.
